purpose: Evaluate a candidate-targeted safe-demotion design that samples Shapley marginal contributions uniformly without replacement inside coalition-size strata, using small finite populations and time-uniform PPR confidence sequences.
design_origin: Theory-driven follow-up after the preregistered permutation-WoR experiment showed valid but conservative rare-effect confidence bounds; this protocol is prospective for the present outcomes but not independent of that preceding observation.
identity: For target i, phi_i=(1/10)*sum_{k=0}^9 mu_{i,k}, where mu_{i,k} is the mean of Delta_i(S)=v(S union {i})-v(S) over all S subset N\{i} of size k.

strata.sampling: For each target and stratum, draw predecessor coalitions uniformly without replacement using a seed-specific random permutation of the stratum population; no outcome-dependent resampling.

allocation.budget_unit: unique coalition-value calls for one target candidate
allocation.why_exact: For a fixed target, distinct predecessor coalitions exclude i and distinct successors include i, so sampled marginal edges have disjoint endpoint identities; each marginal sample costs exactly two unique coalition-value calls.
allocation.waterfill_rule: Allocate samples one at a time to the non-full stratum with the smallest current sample count; break ties by smaller k. Continue until floor(B/2) samples are allocated or all 512 predecessor coalitions are exhausted.
allocation.outcome_independence: Allocation counts depend only on B, k and stratum capacity, never on observed marginal values or sampled coalition identities.

confidence.method: Waudby-Smith and Ramdas 2020 binary hypergeometric prior-posterior-ratio confidence sequence independently within each stratum
confidence.simultaneity_scope: For each target candidate separately, Bonferroni across 10 time-uniform stratum CSs gives familywise <=0.05. This protocol does not claim simultaneous 0.05 control across an unbounded sequence of different target candidates.
confidence.source: Waudby-Smith & Ramdas, Confidence Sequences for Sampling Without Replacement, NeurIPS 2020, Theorem 2.1

point_estimate: At every frozen budget here all 10 strata receive at least one sample; estimate phi_i as the equally weighted mean of the ten observed stratum sample means. A fully enumerated stratum uses its exact mean.

safe_elimination.rule: For target i, certify phi_i<=epsilon only when combined one-sided upper U_i<=epsilon or all 512 target marginals are exactly enumerated.
safe_elimination.exact_zero: Requires exact target marginal enumeration or a structural proof; epsilon-negligibility may stop earlier via the valid upper bound.

metrics: stratum sample allocation at each budget
comparison against the global permutation-WoR protocol, explicitly noting that the present cost is per target candidate

comparison_rules.exact_truth: Compute exact Shapley only after this protocol is durable.
comparison_rules.fairness_note: Permutation-WoR amortizes one global coalition cache across estimates for all players; this candidate-targeted protocol spends its stated budget on one candidate. Compare them as alternatives for a single candidate-demotion decision, not as equal-cost all-player estimators.

next_action: Implement the fixed waterfill allocation and per-stratum PPR CS, validate each finite-population CS endpoint against brute-force tiny populations, then run seeds 0..999 at the frozen budget grid without changing any rule after outcomes.
